# Global Schools Program

> Global Schools Program empowers educators and students worldwide to integrate Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) and UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) into K-12 curricula.

The Global Schools Program is a comprehensive initiative that connects schools globally through a network of trained educators and advocates committed to sustainable development education. The program provides multilingual resources, lesson plans, and professional development opportunities for teachers implementing ESD and SDG-aligned curricula.

## Key Topics

- Education for Sustainable Development (ESD)
- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Global Schools Advocates Program
- Teacher Training & Professional Development
- Curriculum Integration
- Global Citizenship
- Lesson Plans & Classroom Resources
- STEAM Education
- Environmental Education
- UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)
- Goal 7 (Renewable Energy)
- Multilingual Resources
- K-12 Education
- School Networks

## Educational Resources & Lesson Plans

- [LESSON PLANS | Global Schools](https://www.globalschoolsprogram.org/resources-for-educators): Multilingual lesson plans and classroom materials for K12 educators
- [Global Schools | Activities Guides](https://www.globalschoolsprogram.org/activitiesguide): SDG activities and guides supporting K12 classroom instruction
- [RESOURCES | Global Schools](https://www.globalschoolsprogram.org/resources): Resources library for ESD benefits and 21st-century skills
- [FOR STUDENTS | Global Schools](https://www.globalschoolsprogram.org/resources-for-students): Student resources including games and video-based learning tools
- [Global Schools | Case Studies](https://www.globalschoolsprogram.org/case-studies): Case studies showcasing Global Schools Advocates implementing ESD

## Global Network & Partnerships

- [NETWORK | Global Schools](https://www.globalschoolsprogram.org/network): Network directory for school membership and global SDG commitments
- [Global Schools | Mission 4.7](https://www.globalschoolsprogram.org/schoolsforsdg7): Mission 4.7 taskforce advancing SDG 4.7 with renewable energy curriculum
